data.title: AI is an 'existential competition' between China and the U.S., so AI buildout will continue: PM
data.description: Martin Schulz, Head of International Equity Group at Federated Hermes explains why he thinks AI spending will be deferred, but the AI build-out will not be derailed despite mid-term election results and last week's massive market sell-off. He also shares his view on Japan, India and China markets.
